candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum, leaving it at its initial value.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so MinSum can still be changed even after initialization, making later SetMinSum calls observable.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so the stored value differs from the argument whenever _val is nonzero.

Replace `locked_ = true;` with `locked_ = false;` so the reentrancy lock never engages, allowing reentrant SetMinSum calls (e.g. via Collect's external call) to succeed and change MinSum where the original would revert.
Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so every nonReentrant_ function, including SetMinSum, reverts when called normally, keeping MinSum at its initial value.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = add_uint256(_val, 1);` so the stored MinSum is one greater than requested.
Delete the assignment `MinSum = _val;` so MinSum is never updated by SetMinSum.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetMinSum can still change MinSum after initialization, whereas the original reverts and leaves MinSum unchanged.

Delete `locked_ = false;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released and any second call to SetMinSum reverts, leaving MinSum unchanged (unlike the original which allows each non-reentrant call to succeed).
Delete the statement that assigns LogFile(_log) to Log, so Log stays address(0) after SetLogFile.
Replace the Log assignment with an assignment of the zero address so the Log getter returns address(0) instead of _log.
Delete the initialized guard so SetLogFile can also overwrite Log after Initialized() has been called, changing the value returned by the Log getter.
